title: FULL ROW
pitch: Place the names. Fill a row and the names on it get painted together.

title: UNBREAKABLE
pitch: Aim and fire: every brick you break is a name of the wall, and it gets painted.

title: STAR RUNNER
pitch: Collect stars, avoid spikes and reach the beacon in all three levels.

title: SKY HOPPER
pitch: Tap, press Space or the up arrow to flap between the pipes.
